p.s: People hold different opinions of whether or not young people enjoy life more that older people do.
One may claim that young people can enjoy life more since they have more energy.
However, i will argue that people can enjoy life equally, both the youngs and the elders.
The first reason in support of my view is that people have equal right in terms of enjoying life.
Nowadays, numerous games and activities tends to become suitable to people at any ages.
Traveling would be a perfect example to prove my argument.
More and more travel agencies provide different trips and vacations regarding to the differences of ages.
Elder people can join and group for seniors, likewise, youngsters can participate one designed for their age.
Second of all, people enjoy life in the same level although they may do activities in different ways.
The acitivities that young people like to do, such as video games or extreme sports, the seniors may not enjoy doing.
Instead, they may like prefer doing other things, like gardening or cooking.
However, there is no definition that tell people which games are more fascinating or which activities are tedious.
When it come to how to enjoy life, it more likely to depend on different people.
last but not least, some people may argue that the people are more energitic to do more activities.
In my point of view, due to the amazing developments of modern medicines and health care, the elders are in better healthy conditions which provide them to enjoy some highly active sports as well.
The man, who is in his seventies, go to swim everyday in the morning.
I believe some young people even cannot keep this everyday routin.
The youngs may not have interest on it, or they even do n't have sufficient time to do it as some older people.
In conclusion, i am highly convinced that both the youngs and the olders enjoy life equally since they have the same rights, although they may enjoy life by participating different activities.
Besides, the contribution of the medical science on seniors health also increases the opportunies to do more activities for them
